source.name: Football Shirt Culture: Egypt 2026 Puma Home Kit
source.note: Kit maker. Named-press kit write-up: the shirt carries the Egyptian Football Association crest and the gold Puma logo on the chest only; the reverse is predominantly red with a small gold inscription below the collar, the sleeves are solid red, and the kit is completed with matching red shorts and socks. No commercial sponsor on any placement.
source.quote: The Egyptian Football Association crest is positioned on the left chest, accompanied by multiple gold stars above, while the Puma logo appears on the right chest in matching gold.

summary: Puma home kit for the 2026 World Cup cycle. No commercial shirt sponsors: Football Shirt Culture's launch write-up describes only the EFA crest and Puma branding on the shirt, a sponsor-free reverse and sleeves, with matching sponsor-free shorts and socks.
